mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine stimulates sympathomimetic activity and increases cardiovascular stress while vancomycin can cause nephrotoxicity, creating additive risks particularly in renal impairment; minimal direct pharmacokinetic interaction.
action: Monitor renal function, blood pressure, and heart rate closely; ensure adequate hydration; use lowest effective amphetamine dose and consider alternative ADHD therapy if vancomycin-induced renal dysfunction develops.
